missing_evidence: Order service application logs with stack traces or exception detail for the 500s to identify the failing code path
Order dependency call spans (db, cache, downstream) to confirm whether the 500s are self-caused or downstream-induced
candidates.statement: Order service is the degraded component: its checkout span errored at 1650ms, error_rate is 0.24 with p95 520ms, and logs show 9 unhandled_request_failure events returning HTTP 500. Gateway and payment remain healthy (low error rate, OK spans, 200 logs), localizing the fault to order.
candidates.uncertainty: Root mechanism behind the order 500s is not established; only the failing service and symptom are bounded.

report.explanation: Order is the only service with errors: errored checkout span, 24% error rate, elevated p95, and 9 HTTP 500 unhandled failures. Gateway, payment, and inventory are healthy, and the gateway deployment record alone cannot establish causation. Root cause is bounded to order-service HTTP 500s; the underlying mechanism needs order logs and dependency spans.
